facts.business: Restile Ceramics Limited manufactures and sells unpolished smooth tiles and industrial vitrified tiles.

segments.name: Unpolished smooth tiles and Industrial Vitrified Tiles

auditor.name: Not stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Material uncertainty related to going concern due to negative cashflows from operations in earlier years, substantial operating losses, and significant deterioration in value of assets used to generate cash flows; financial statements do not include adjustments that might result from these uncertainties.

key_risks: Material uncertainty related to going concern due to negative cashflows, operating losses, and asset deterioration
Dependence on related party transactions with Bell Granito Ceramica Limited
High current liabilities relative to current assets leading to declining current ratio
Continued net losses despite revenue growth
facts.related_party_note: Approval sought for material related party transactions with Bell Granito Ceramica Limited (BGCL) for an aggregate value of up to Rs. 1,000 Lakhs (Rs. 10 Crore) annually, at arm's length and in ordinary course of business.
